capability.note: datasheet - sold as a metered rack PDU (title, p.1). What it meters is not stated; `metering-scope: input` is the scope the single display could carry and is a stand-in until a source says (gaps: metering-scope). The unit has no switching in any held document: `outlet-switching: false`.

chassis.note: datasheet - AP7821B datasheet: Height 44 mm, Width 444 mm, Depth 102 mm, net weight 1.74 kg (p.1); 1U. Colour read off the p.5 photographs at the median of the face, #33323a, estimated as black matte; no document names one. The drawn colour, #2c2e30, is the library's black-matte estimate for the sibling AP7921B (whose face reads #272d2d in another photograph) and is not taken from this photograph; the lighter reading is lighting.

dcim.note: datasheet - the input is a C20 power port (`iec-60320-c20`) and each outlet an `iec-60320-c13` power outlet fed by it. The outlets are named as the unit prints them, 1 to 8.

display.note: estimated - apc/ap78-display@1. The datasheet's text names no display; the photograph shows the window. The Metered Rack PDU guide's figure calls it the digital display, item 7 (PDF p.11 and p.15).

ears.note: NOT DRAWN. The datasheet lists rack mounting brackets and a cord retention bracket as supplied (p.1) and states "Mounting location Front Rear", "Mounting position Horizontal". No document says where the brackets bolt, so one `flush` position is written without a figure and it is a stand-in (gaps: ears).

front.note: estimated - the plain face, read off the datasheet's p.5 photograph (near front-on, the better of the two views of it): a small round hole near the left end with an earth mark under it, the APC logo with its web address at the right end and a small label under it reading "Metered Rack PDU" in part, the rest not legible. Positions read off the photograph, good to about 3 mm. Which face is the rack front is not stated (gaps: face-names).

input.note: datasheet - "Input Connection Type IEC 60320 C20", input 200 V 208 V 230 V, output 208 V 230 V, 50/60 Hz, input current limit 20 A, rated current 16 A, max current draw 20 A, load capacity 3300 VA, cable 2.4 m (p.1). The datasheet lists no cord among what is provided, so none is drawn and none is stated.

jacks.note: estimated - two jacks shaped like RJ45 jacks at the right end (p.1 photograph). By position they match the Metered Rack PDU guide's figure (PDF p.11). The upper is the 10/100 Base-T network connector, item 3. The lower is the RJ-12 serial port, item 6 (PDF p.15). That guide is for an older series. Each is std/rj45@2, without a role.

lamps.note: estimated - five lamps and a Reset hole at the display end, read off the 369 px p.1 photograph. The display window, 22 mm across, is the scale, about 1.4 mm per pixel. Each lamp is drawn in its off state, and its on states carry the colours of the guide and the photograph; the viewer lights it. The Metered Rack PDU guide (AP7800 series, 2012) gives the identities and states. Its front panel is PDF p.11 and its items PDF p.15. Its Link-RX/TX and Status tables are PDF p.16 and its load indicator table PDF p.17. That guide is for an older series and the B models' own guide, 990-5569E, is not held. The count and place of the lamps come from the photograph and are estimated. The guide's top single-phase figure shows one load lamp above the display. It also shows three legend rings at the left of the display, marked OK, Warning and Overload. The photograph shows three lit points in one column above the right digit. It cannot tell one lamp with three colours from three lamps, so three are placed and each carries one load colour. No B1, B2 or TOTAL lamps are shown. Each sample is a count and a mean over the pixels under a colour mask. The mask for green is G of at least 90 and at least R and B plus 30. The mask for yellow is R and G of at least 150 and B at most R minus 80. The mask for red is R of at least 150, G under 90 and B under R minus 60. Green, count 3, mean #509049, is the colour of `lamp-load-ok`, the green load lamp. Yellow, count 2, mean #cad314, is the colour of `lamp-load-warning`. Red, count 2, mean #d92244, is the colour of `lamp-load-overload`. The Link-RX/TX and Status windows at the right edge of the upper jack are pale and unlit in the photograph. They use the library's green #39b54a and orange #f5a623, as nokia/sr-1-ac does. The guide draws both windows as small upright rectangles, so they use the rectangular part common/led-rect-sm@2, turned a quarter. The rectangles measure about 1.8 x 3.2 mm in the guide's figure at 600 dpi, scaled from the jack frame's 15.8 mm. The part is 2.8 x 1.6 mm, within 13 percent of that, and the larger common/led-rect is 44 percent off. The window heights follow the figure. The guide's place falls inside the library's wider jack, and the overlap check refuses it. So each lamp stands just outside the jack's right edge, as the photograph shows. The upper lamp, `lamp-jack-1`, is Link-RX/TX, item 5. The lower, `lamp-jack-2`, is Status, item 4, as in the figure. Status states: off, green valid TCP/IP, flashing green not valid, orange hardware failure, flashing orange BOOTP, alternating orange and green DHCP. Link-RX/TX states: off, flashing green 10 Mbps, flashing orange 100 Mbps, and solid green or orange with no traffic. Load states: green normal, yellow near overload, red overload. The Reset hole is item 8. It is a dark dot of about 2.5 mm at the lower left of the display, good to about 3 mm.

method.note: NO DRAWING EXISTS AND THE ONLY PICTURES ARE 369 PX DATASHEET PHOTOGRAPHS, so every position is an estimate. Searched: the APC AP7821B datasheet (6 pp), the Schneider Electric release notes for the network card (990-6391K, no figure of a PDU) and the intake's coverage report; none dimensions a face, and no installation guide, drawing, stencil or CAD file is held. The datasheet's p.5 outlet-face photograph is taken at an angle, so no pitch can be measured on it. The datasheet's p.1 photograph of this model's outlet face is near front-on, but it was used only to check order and the pitch roughly, not to re-read each position. The positions here are the ones read off the AP7921B's near-front-on photograph (see apc/ap7921b), checked against this model's photographs for order: inlet, eight outlets, display, button, two jacks, logo. THE POSITIONS ARE BORROWED, NOT MEASURED ON THIS MODEL (gaps: face-positions); a re-reading of the right-hand end on the p.1 photograph is still to do.

outlets.note: datasheet - "Number of power socket outlets 8 IEC 60320 C13" (p.1); each is std/c13-outlet@1. "Protection type Without circuit breaker" (p.1). No per-outlet rating and no bank is stated.

rear.note: estimated - the outlet face, mm from the face's left and top, borrowed from the AP7921B photograph reading (see `method`). The inlet's centre is at 17. Eight outlets start at 55 on a 36.1 pitch, numbered 1 to 8 under their mouths as printed. The display's window runs from 333 to 355 across. The round button is centred at 376 and the two jacks at 397. The logo is right of them, with five small lamps and a Reset hole (see `lamps`). The inlet is empty in this photograph.
